newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal union group presses for 3.8 pct wage deal.
newsitem.headline: Portugal union group presses for 3.8 pct wage deal.

text.p: The General Workers Union (UGT), traditionally close to the ruling Socialist Party, will press for public sector wage rises of 3.8 percent, significantly above the government s offer, its secretary-general said on Monday.
Joao Proenca told a news conference that the wage demand was based on an expected inflation of 2.5 percent next year plus forecast productivity gains of 2.2 percent.

The government has offered a 2.38 percent rise to public sector workers, saying any more could jeopardise Portugal's chances of meeting budget deficit and inflation targets set for entry to the European Union's Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
